evidence: A satisfying settlement can select the nine-monitor package, purchase and install nine monitors for $4,320 using the restricted capital account with no general-fund transfer, set alerts to 1,000 ppm, schedule weekly first-quarter nurse reviews, credit PF1/PF2/PF3, and cite all three after revelation. A plausible six-monitor, $3,100 general-fund settlement with default settings would fail multiple checks.
